routes:
# TeleCod short public URLs
# The destination pages read the slug from the query string.
# 200 = rewrite, so the browser keeps the short URL.

# PasteLink
/p/* /paste-view.html?slug=:splat 200

# Telegram Code
/c/p/* /product.html 200
/c/f/* /product.html 200

# Telegram Channel / Group
/ch/p/* /product.html?type=channel&slug=:splat 200
/ch/f/* /product.html?type=channel&slug=:splat 200
/g/p/* /product.html?type=group&slug=:splat 200
/g/f/* /product.html?type=group&slug=:splat 200

# Free Paste
/paste/* /product.html?type=paste&slug=:splat 200
notes: Public /c/f/* and /c/p/* routes resolve through product.html and product.js
product.js has guarded fallback for older databases missing get_code_by_slug
